column4: Changed text, numbers or trailing bytes in a temporary fact cache now trigger recovery from the original run logs.
Older fact caches rebuild once with an integrity check; original history, saved games and statistics calculations stay unchanged.
Added regressions for text and number damage, trailing data, unchanged raw history, old-cache migration and large Unicode caches.
Recorded TEST86's actual publication and the fact-cache failure, tests, timing and remaining audit limitations.
I found that damaged cache data could still look like valid text or numbers. The cache now checks its integrity and rebuilds from original logs when needed.
